dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, pale-to-white margins bordering dark grey-brown centers on folded primaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, sharp horizontal boundary separates the uniform pale crown from the dark, scaly pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast imbricated pattern created by dark central feather pigmentation and broad light-colored distal fringes across the entire dorsal surface.
